examples.text: The loud music affected my sleep.
The strike had a serious effect on the city.
Too little water can affect your concentration.
The effects of the storm were clear the next day.
How does homework affect your free time?
The advertisement had little effect on sales.
examples.note: Have an effect = cause a result

examples.text: The sad news affected everyone in the office.
The medicine began to take effect after an hour.
Bright light affects the way we feel.
The film's special effects were very good.
examples.note: Special effects = tricks in a film

examples.text: Does exercise have a positive effect on sleep?
examples.note: A positive effect = a good result

examples.text: My brother was deeply affected by the story.
One effect of the heat is that people drink more water.
Changes in the weather often affect my mood.
The teacher's advice had a strong effect on him.
examples.note: A strong effect = a big result

examples.text: Smoking can affect your health for many years.
The cold weather effected our holiday plans.
examples.correction: The cold weather affected our holiday plans.
examples.note: The verb is affect, not effect

examples.text: The new teacher had a good affect on the class.
examples.correction: The new teacher had a good effect on the class.
examples.note: A result is an effect (a noun)

examples.text: Loud noise can effect your hearing.
examples.correction: Loud noise can affect your hearing.
examples.note: After can, use the verb affect

examples.text: The affects of the flood lasted for months.
examples.correction: The effects of the flood lasted for months.

examples.text: How will the new bus times effect you?
examples.correction: How will the new bus times affect you?
examples.note: After will, use the verb affect

examples.text: Reading before bed has a calming affect.
examples.correction: Reading before bed has a calming effect.

examples.text: The accident deeply effected his family.
examples.correction: The accident deeply affected his family.

examples.text: Sugar has a bad affect on children's teeth.
examples.correction: Sugar has a bad effect on children's teeth.
examples.note: A bad effect = a bad result

examples.text: Missing breakfast can effect your energy.

examples.text: The medicine took affect quickly.

examples.text: Her speech had a big affect on me.

examples.text: The new rules will not effect students.

examples.text: What affect did the news have on you?

examples.text: The heavy rain effected the match.
